notes: New horror mod: Twixxel's Stalker (Mods > Converted - off until you turn it on). Something stalks you: it watches from far off or uncomfortably close and is gone if you get near, leaving you in darkness; it appears right behind you; and sometimes it hunts you, only moving while you aren't looking and breaking through anything in its way. Bad weather brings it more often. By MrPerkasc, idea Twixxel_lesgo, designs LCrandom.

It works in singleplayer and on servers with the HybridStalker plugin. Only players who turn it on are stalked, and only they can see it. It hits hard (5 hearts) and its chase breaks blocks - you have been warned.
